title: The multi-agent scenarios are measured in paid runs as the operator sized them
goal: once the operator answers the paid-run gate, the scenarios lookups, research and mixed run as answered, at once and with --sequential, with each knob run the answer keeps; multi check runs on each paid run and its failures are recorded as check_failures rows; multi record merges each run's rows and deltas into kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.csv; the report's multi section and README's figures are regenerated from those rows; each of those runs has its bare twin run at the same time with multi run --bare as the bare-arm spend gate of SP-3pvz2noj answered, its rows recorded beside the kb arm's; the sprint's paid runs stop at 300 USD in total, both arms counted

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print("check failed:", e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail

import csv, sys
m = [x for x in csv.DictReader(open("kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.csv", encoding="utf-8"))
     if x["scenario"] == "multi" and x["date"] > "2026-10-18"]
cases = {x["case"] for x in m}
arms = {x["arm"] for x in m}
print(sorted(cases), sorted(arms)[:20])
assert {"lookups", "research", "mixed"} <= cases, cases
assert any(a.startswith("concurrent") for a in arms) and any(a.startswith("sequential") for a in arms), arms
assert any(a.startswith("delta") for a in arms), arms
assert any(x["metric"] == "check_failures" for x in m), "no fitness check result recorded"

import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print("check failed:", e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail

import csv
m = [x for x in csv.DictReader(open("kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.csv", encoding="utf-8"))
     if x["scenario"] == "multi" and x["date"] > "2026-10-18" and "replay" not in x["arm"].split()]
bare = [x for x in m if x["arm"].startswith("bare ")]
print(sorted({x["case"] for x in bare}), len(bare))
assert {"lookups", "research", "mixed"} <= {x["case"] for x in bare}, "a scenario has no bare twin run"
assert any(x["arm"].startswith("bare concurrent") for x in bare) and any(x["arm"].startswith("bare sequential") for x in bare), "a start order has no bare twin"
spent = sum(float(x["value"]) for x in m if x["metric"] == "usd" and not x["arm"].startswith("delta"))
print("spent", round(spent, 2))
assert 0 < spent <= 300, f"the paid runs spent {spent:.2f} USD, both arms counted: above the 300 USD stop or none recorded"

gates.question: Spend for the paid multi-agent runs; the operator answers this gate, an orchestrator leaves it open. Run as sized: 2 reps of 15 runs, 30 runs, about 157 USD, about 6 h one after another. Smaller sample: 1 rep of 12 runs without the Opus, reading-files and manager-session runs, about 58 USD, about 2.5 h. Estimated from the recorded rows' means at bench_core.PRICE (this item's notes) and printed again by multi run --dry-run before the runs.

How are the 30 paid runs started and which knob values do they use? Orchestrator starts them detached (a run outlasts a headless worker; fresh --dir per run, --bare on each, --max-usd min(dry-run estimate x 1.25, 300 minus both arms' recorded spend), stop under 25 GB free, multi check per run into DIR/check.txt); per rep: lookups, research, mixed at once and --sequential; research --coord isolated; lookups --stagger 30; lookups --model lookup=sonnet-5-5 in place of the Haiku knob, since the lookup default already is haiku-5-5; research --model research=haiku-5-5; lookups --pack-budget 600 and 2400; lookups --tools files; mixed --manager session; lookups --model lookup=opus-5-5. Dry-run estimate both arms about 134.5 USD per rep, about 269 for 2.
Where does multi record take the check_failures count from?
options: record runs the same checks as multi check itself and counts the problems; no row while an agent has no end stamp
record reads the problem count from the run's check.txt

Planning estimate (recorded rows' means at bench_core.PRICE), per rep: concurrent lookups 2.94 USD (20 questions x 0.147 Sonnet), research 8.48 (3 areas x 2.83), mixed 8.39 (2 areas, 2 code items x about 1.0, 5 questions); the sequential baseline the same 19.81; knob runs: dedup off 8.48, staggered start 2.94, Haiku lookups 0.17, Opus lookups 4.72, Haiku research about 1.0 (no recorded row), pack budget 600 and 2400 5.88, reading files about 4.41 (1.5x the kb arm, no recorded row), an orchestrator session as manager about 11.39 (mixed plus about 3, no recorded row): 78.61 USD and 15 runs per rep, about 2.9 h one after another (573 s per area, 28 s per question, about 900 s per code item, no recorded row). Run as sized: 2 reps, 30 runs, about 157 USD, about 6 h. Smaller sample: 1 rep without the Opus, reading-files and manager-session runs, 12 runs, about 58 USD, about 2.5 h.
